principalInvestigator.name: Emre Kocakavuk, MD, PhD
principalInvestigator.description: Dr. Emre Kocakavuk is a Clinician Scientist and an Emmy Noether Group Leader in the Department of Hematology and Stem Cell Transplantation at the West German Cancer Center & Institute for AI in Medicine (IKIM).

members.name: Quan Shi, MBBS, PhD
members.description: Dr. Quan Shi is an Alexander von Humboldt Fellow developing single-cell and spatial transcriptomics methods for central nervous system lymphoma (CNSL) and glioma.

members.name: Fabian Ullrich, MD
members.description: Dr. Fabian Ullrich joined the lab as a UMEA-funded Clinician Scientist. He currently performs a postdoctoral fellowship in the Zuber Lab at IMP in Vienna, Austria.

members.name: Cihat Karadag, MD
members.description: Cihat Karadag is a Clinician Scientist with an interest in aggressive brain tumors and leverages real-world clinicogenomic glioma datasets.

members.name: Marco Tembrink, MD
members.description: Marco Tembrink is a UMEA-funded Clinician Scientist studying complex genomic events in cancer, with a focus on CNS lymphomas.

members.name: Katharina Ruff, MD
members.description: Dr. Katharina Ruff is a Clinician Scientist with a focus on the epigenetic mechanisms driving cancers, with a focus on CNS lymphomas.

members.name: Nachiyappan Venkatachalam, MSc
members.description: Nachi Venkatachalam joined as a lab manager and supports the lab with pre-clinical disease models and spatial-omics based analyses.

members.name: Pranav Swaroop Gundla, MSc
members.description: Pranav Swaroop Gundla is a CANTAR-funded PhD student and focuses on applying deep learning methods in computational pathology.

members.name: Yinchun Su, MSc
members.description: Yinchun Su is a DFG-funded PhD student and focuses on integrative computational analyses of aggressive intracranial tumors.

members.name: Jiawei Zhou, MD
members.description: Jiawei Zhou is a Visiting Researcher collaborating with the lab on systematic analyses of real-world clinico-genomic datasets.

members.name: Jonayed Sarkar, BSc
members.description: Jonayed Sarkar is pursuing a Master’s degree in Data Science at TU Dortmund University and supports the team as a Student Research Assistant.

members.name: Anastasija Ivančukova
members.description: Anastasija is a fifth-year medical student from Latvia, joining the lab for a summer research placement in clinico-genomic studies of central nervous system lymphoma.

members.name: Mahsasadat Nezamabadi, BSc
members.description: Mahsasadat Nezamabadi is pursuing a Master’s degree in Applied Computer Science at the University of Duisburg-Essen and supports the team as a Student Research Assistant.

members.name: Fatma Atak
members.description: Fatma Atak is an undergraduate student in Electrical and Electronics Engineering at Marmara University, Istanbul, Turkey. She joined the lab through the Erasmus Exchange Program.
